sources.entry: ChefInspector - Node and Attribute viewer for Chef

summary.one_liner: A macOS app for browsing nodes and their attributes from a Chef server configuration.
summary.what_it_does: Connects to a Chef server using the local ~/.config.rb configuration file and lists its nodes. The node list is cached until the user clicks Clear to refresh it. The list can be filtered by a query string. Selecting a node queries Chef for its attributes, which are also cached. Attributes can be expanded in a tree view, with option-click expanding an entire subtree. A search field at the bottom of the attribute display filters the attributes by string.
use_cases: Browse Chef nodes on a Mac
Inspect node attributes from a Chef server
Search Chef node names with a filter
notable: Reads the existing local ~/.config.rb Chef configuration, so no separate setup is described
Caches nodes and attributes locally to reduce repeated server queries
Option-click expands an entire attribute subtree
Built-in string filter for attribute display
caveats: Only macOS is mentioned in the README
Requires a configured Chef server and local ~/.config.rb file
No installation or build instructions are given in the README
